material_policy: URDF STL visual sRGB colour embedded as Lambert DAE; Lichtblick converts Lambert to Standard roughness1/dithering, matching source STL marker material.
allocation_method: Per-link semantic minimum plus source surface-area/bounding-box-area weights; source face density does not determine the allocation.
simplification_losses: Local curved shells and round joints become coarser; small fastener bores, bevels and interior CAD relief may disappear.
Each original visual link remains independently positioned and articulated; no link/axis/joint/visual-origin merge.
Local voxel union removes internal shell layers/small fasteners and approximates source surfaces at the reported voxel resolution.
Decorative lettering is omitted in all three tiers; its original link/visual remains as an intentional empty DAE scene.
Low-tier finger links retain the medium-tier per-link budget to avoid the visible joint-end retreat found in the first low prototype; other low body budgets remain unchanged.
verification_scope: Exported coordinates/normals/winding and unchanged source/URDF contracts; all non-decoration candidate visual shells closed. Source topology reported separately. Same-camera pixel QA pending.
